selected_evidence.requirement: Baseline: node1<->node2 traffic flows normally and node3 does NOT see it before mirroring is configured
selected_evidence.summary: Ping from node1 to node2 succeeded (0% loss) while a concurrent tcpdump on node3's eth0 captured zero packets, confirming the segment is a switched L2 domain requiring explicit mirroring.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mirroring implementation delivers a copy of node1<->node2 traffic to node3 with original addressing preserved
selected_evidence.summary: iptables mangle TEE rules installed on node1 (PREROUTING for src=node2, OUTPUT for dst=node2, gateway=node3); after pinging node1->node2, node3's tcpdump on eth0 captured both the echo request and reply packets addressed to 10.100.28.10/10.100.28.11, and the TEE rule counters incremented (4 and 8 packets matching the 4 pings).

selected_evidence.requirement: Original node1<->node2 traffic keeps flowing unaffected by the mirroring
selected_evidence.summary: Multiple ping tests between node1 and node2 (before, during, and after mirroring setup, and after each restart) consistently showed 0% packet loss and normal latency.

selected_evidence.requirement: Mirroring configuration persists across a node1 reboot (restart-survivability)
selected_evidence.summary: Created and enabled systemd unit traffic-mirror.service plus /etc/modules-load.d entry for xt_TEE; after node1's restart the service was active and the TEE rules were present again automatically (0/0 packet counters, freshly reset).

selected_evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline captured on every node before restart (boot identity + working state)
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id, machine-id, and uptime on node1, node2, and node3, plus node1's active mirror service and TEE rule counters, prior to any restarts.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 restarted one at a time with changed boot identity proven, then service/functionality recovery verified
selected_evidence.summary: node1 reboot acknowledged before disconnect (background-scheduled), subsequent execs failed with connection reset (mid-reboot), then boot_id changed from 8e8823ec... to 5af44431..., systemd service and TEE rules confirmed active, and a fresh ping+tcpdump round-trip proved mirroring works post-restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: node2 restarted one at a time with changed boot identity proven, then connectivity/mirroring recovery verified
selected_evidence.summary: node2 reboot acknowledged before disconnect, boot_id changed from c2ffc729... to 453a66a3..., eth0 addressing restored (10.100.28.11/24), and a post-restart ping+tcpdump test confirmed node1<->node2 traffic still mirrored to node3.

selected_evidence.requirement: node3 restarted one at a time with changed boot identity proven, then capture capability/mirroring recovery verified
selected_evidence.summary: node3 reboot acknowledged before disconnect, boot_id changed from a0d04bc6... to 1b38f7c8..., eth0 addressing restored (10.100.28.12/24), and a final full end-to-end test after all three nodes had cycled showed node1<->node2 ping succeeding at 0% loss with node3's tcpdump capturing the mirrored ICMP request/reply pairs.
